description:
This tool calls the Actor "gouda_studios/youtube-transcript-extractor" and retrieves its output results.
Actor description: Get the transcript of any YouTube video or Short as clean text, timestamped text, segments and SRT. Bulk URLs, any language, auto-translate. Pay only for transcripts you get; failed videos are free.

includeSegments.description:
Add an array of segments with start time and duration.
Example values: true
includeSegments.title: Include timed segments

includeSrt.description: Add an SRT subtitle file as a string.
includeSrt.title: Include SRT subtitles

languages.description:
Language codes in priority order, e.g. en, es, de. If none match, the first available transcript is returned.
Example values: ["en"]

items.description: Language codes in priority order, e.g. en, es, de. If none match, the first available transcript is returned.
items.title: Preferred languages

languages.title: Preferred languages

maxVideos.description:
Stop after this many videos.
Example values: 1000
maxVideos.title: Max videos

preferManual.description:
Use manually created captions over auto-generated ones when both exist.
Example values: true
preferManual.title: Prefer human-made captions

proxyConfiguration.description:
Optional. Leave off to use our built-in residential proxy, included in the price. Set your own only if you want to.
Example values: {"useApifyProxy":false}

apifyProxyGroups.description:
Select specific Apify Proxy groups to use (e.g., RESIDENTIAL, DATACENTER).
**DATACENTER:**
The fastest and cheapest option. It uses datacenters to change your IP address. Note that there is a chance of being blocked because of the activity of other users.

**RESIDENTIAL:**
IP addresses located in homes and offices around the world. These IPs are the least likely to be blocked.
apifyProxyGroups.title: Apify Proxy Groups

proxyUrls.description: List of custom proxy URLs to be used instead of the Apify Proxy.
proxyUrls.title: Proxy URLs

useApifyProxy.description: Whether to use Apify Proxy. Set this to false when you want to use custom proxy URLs.
useApifyProxy.title: Use Apify Proxy

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy

translateTo.description: Language code to auto-translate the transcript into using YouTube's translation, e.g. en.
translateTo.title: Translate to (optional)

videos.description:
**REQUIRED** Watch URLs, youtu.be links, Shorts, live or embed URLs, or bare 11-character video IDs.
Example values: ["https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ"]

items.description: **REQUIRED** Watch URLs, youtu.be links, Shorts, live or embed URLs, or bare 11-character video IDs.
items.title: YouTube video URLs or IDs

videos.title: YouTube video URLs or IDs

waitSecs.description: Max seconds (0–45, default 30) to cap the wait for the Actor run to reach terminal state. For long-running Actors the response returns at the cap with the current run status; follow `nextStep` to poll via get-actor-run. Set to 0 to fire-and-forget.
